content.title: Still Not A Joke: Dunkin’® is Giving Away 1,000,001 Free Coffees This April Fools’ Day | Dunkin'
content.text: Sign up for Email Alerts Newsroom Blog Post Food + Beverages April 01, 2026 Still Not A Joke: Dunkin’® is Giving Away 1,000,001 Free Coffees This April Fools’ Day Last April Fools’, we gave away a million free coffees, and some of you thought it was a prank. We didn’t forget that. So this year, we’re doing it again. Just a little bigger We’re giving away 1,000,001 free coffees. That extra one is for anyone still not convinced. On Wednesday, April 1, Dunkin’ Rewards members can get a FREE Cup of Coffee*. No tricks, just your coffee run, on us. All you have to do is open your Dunkin’ app and enter the promo code StillNotAJoke. April Fools’ might come with some trust issues, but we’re here to help you get through it. Whether you’re dodging office pranks or scrolling past one too many fake announcements, we’ve got your back – and your coffee. Happy April Fools’ Day. And yes, this is still not a joke. Stay up-to-date on all things Dunkin’ by following on social media (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube) and subscribe to the Dunkin’ blog to receive notifications at news.dunkindonuts.com/blog. *Promo Code valid on 4/1. Free Coffee Certificate valid for 7 days after promo code entry. Cold Brew and Extra-Large Hot Coffee not included. Limit 1 per customer. Additional terms and exclusions may apply.
